# Playdigo

> Playdigo is a performance advertising platform for mobile apps, CTV, display, audio and web. Advertisers buy through PlayDSP and publishers monetize through PlaySSP. Founded in 2019, headquartered in San Francisco with teams in Tel Aviv, APAC and the US.

Key facts
- 150B+ auctions daily across 350,000+ apps and 44,000+ publishers and media partners
- Campaigns optimize on MMP events through full integrations with AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Branch and Kochava
- TAG certified
- Every advertiser works with a named account lead and the Performance Lab, a team of strategists, creatives and analysts

## Products
- [PlayDSP for advertisers](https://playdigo.com/solutions/for-advertisers): performance advertising for app growth across mobile, CTV and web
- [PlaySSP for publishers](https://playdigo.com/solutions/for-publishers): app monetization with more demand in every auction

## Case studies
- [BIGO Ads](https://playdigo.com/case-studies/bigo-ads): 486% revenue growth, 93% sRCPM improvement, 152% impressions growth
- [Verve](https://playdigo.com/case-studies/verve-group): 425% combined revenue growth, rCPM lifts of 143% and 328%

## Guides
- [How to Protect ROAS in Q4 and the Holiday Season](https://playdigo.com/blog/maximizing-roas-during-q4-holiday-season)
- [How to Choose an SSP Partner for Your App](https://playdigo.com/blog/evaluating-and-selecting-the-right-ssp-partner-in-2026)
- [Alternatives to Meta Ads for App Installs](https://playdigo.com/blog/alternatives-to-meta-ads-for-app-installs)

## Company
- [About Playdigo](https://playdigo.com/about)
- [Contact](https://playdigo.com/contact)

Intelligence that knows how to play

MEET DIGO

Intelligence
that knows
how to play

DecisioningIntelligenceGrowthOperator

Digo weighs audience fit, contextual signals, supply quality, pacing, creative response, and outcome history together. No single model owns the answer; the framework compares signals before each decision moves forward.

At auction speed, Digo checks expected value, pacing pressure, placement quality, fraud signals, and demand fit. Weak opportunities can be slowed, skipped, or reprioritized before they drain spend.

Each impression is scored against the outcome in play: CPI, CPA, ROAS, retention, reach, rCPM, fill, or revenue. Strong paths earn more weight. Wasteful paths get filtered earlier.

Wins, losses, clicks, conversions, creative response, viewability, placement context, fill, and revenue feed back into the framework. Digo learns from marketplace behavior instead of relying on fixed assumptions.

A placement that works for reach may not work for ROAS. Digo weighs each bid against the campaign's KPI, audience fit, creative format, pacing needs, and likely downstream value.

Automation handles bid-time evaluation, while the Playdigo team shapes strategy, reviews learning patterns, and adjusts how the framework is applied across advertiser and publisher goals.

About Playdigo

Performance obsessed since 2019.

Playdigo was built to make performance advertising live up to its name. To replace guesswork with intelligence, vanity metrics with measurable business growth, and short-term wins with long-term partnership. It started with a bet between two industry veterans at a ping pong table. It's grown into a global performance platform running billions of auctions a day for marketers and publishers around the world.
